Bash(node -e "require\('dotenv'\).config\(\); const db=require\('./src/database/connection'\); \(async\(\)=>{ const pad=n=>String\(n\).padStart\(2,'0'\); const d=new Date\(\); const utc=d.getUTCFullYear\(\)+'-'+pad\(d.getUTCMonth\(\)+1\)+'-'+pad\(d.getUTCDate\(\)\)+' '+pad\(d.getUTCHours\(\)\)+':'+pad\(d.getUTCMinutes\(\)\)+':'+pad\(d.getUTCSeconds\(\)\); const [id1]=await db\('mensagens'\).insert\({remetente_id:1,destinatario_id:2,conteudo:'diagDate',created_at:new Date\(\),updated_at:new Date\(\)}\); const [id2]=await db\('mensagens'\).insert\({remetente_id:1,destinatario_id:2,conteudo:'diagStr',created_at:utc,updated_at:utc}\); const rows=await db\('mensagens'\).whereIn\('id',[id1,id2]\).select\('id','conteudo','created_at'\); console.log\('insert Date vs string:', rows\); const notif=await db\('notificacoes'\).select\('id','updated_at','created_at'\).orderBy\('id','desc'\).first\(\); console.log\('notificacao recente:', notif\); const lidas=await db\('mensagens'\).whereNotNull\('lida_em'\).select\('id','lida_em'\).limit\(3\); console.log\('lida_em amostras:', lidas\); await db\('mensagens'\).where\('conteudo','like','diag%'\).del\(\); await db.destroy\(\); }\)\(\).catch\(e=>{console.error\(e.message\);process.exit\(1\)}\)")

Bash(node -e "require\('dotenv'\).config\(\); require\('./src/config/database'\); const db=require\('./src/database/connection'\); const svc=require\('./src/services/mensagem.service'\); \(async\(\)=>{ await db\('mensagens'\).where\('created_at','0000-00-00 00:00:00'\).update\({created_at: db.raw\('UTC_TIMESTAMP\(\)'\)}\); await db\('mensagens'\).where\('updated_at','0000-00-00 00:00:00'\).update\({updated_at: db.raw\('created_at'\)}\); await db\('mensagens'\).where\('lida_em','0000-00-00 00:00:00'\).update\({lida_em: null}\); const enviado=await svc.enviarMensagem\(1,2,'verif-fix'\); console.log\('NOVA created_at =', JSON.stringify\(enviado.created_at\)\); await svc.marcarConversaLida\(2,1\); const rows=await db\('mensagens'\).select\('id','conteudo','created_at','lida_em'\).orderBy\('id','asc'\); rows.forEach\(r=>{ const d=new Date\(String\(r.created_at\).replace\(' ','T'\)+'Z'\); console.log\('id '+r.id, r.conteudo, '| created:', r.created_at, '| Brasilia:', isNaN\(d\)?'INVALIDO':d.toLocaleString\('pt-BR',{timeZone:'America/Sao_Paulo',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}\), '| lida_em:', r.lida_em\); }\); await db\('mensagens'\).where\('conteudo','verif-fix'\).del\(\); await db.destroy\(\); }\)\(\).catch\(e=>{console.error\(e.message\);process.exit\(1\)}\)")

Bash(node -e "require\('dotenv'\).config\(\); require\('./src/config/database'\); const db=require\('./src/database/connection'\); const svc=require\('./src/services/mensagem.service'\); const parse=p=>{ if\(!p\) return []; if\(Array.isArray\(p\)\) return p; if\(typeof p==='string'\){try{const j=JSON.parse\(p\); return Array.isArray\(j\)?j:Object.entries\(j\).filter\(\([,v]\)=>v===true\).map\(\([k]\)=>k\);}catch{return [];}} return Object.entries\(p\).filter\(\([,v]\)=>v===true\).map\(\([k]\)=>k\); }; \(async\(\)=>{ const us=await db\('usuarios as u'\).leftJoin\('roles as r','u.role_id','r.id'\).where\('u.ativo',true\).select\('u.id','u.nome','r.nome as role','u.permissoes as up','r.permissoes as rp'\); console.log\('Usuarios ativos:'\); us.forEach\(u=>{ const tem = u.role==='admin' || [...parse\(u.up\),...parse\(u.rp\)].includes\('chat_usar'\); console.log\('  id',u.id, '|', u.nome, '| role:', u.role, '| chat_usar:', tem\); }\); const contatos=await svc.listarContatos\(1\); console.log\('listarContatos\(1\) =>', contatos.map\(c=>\({id:c.id,nome:c.nome}\)\)\); await db.destroy\(\); }\)\(\).catch\(e=>{console.error\(e.message\);process.exit\(1\)}\)")
